scalars.scalar_value: One year recent outpatient medical clinic clerical experience

items.item_text: One year recent outpatient medical clinic clerical experience

Schedules patient appointments which includes initial, recheck and pre-ops. Updates schedule changes and performs necessary rescheduling of patients and prints and distributes daily clinic schedule. Provides clerical support for outgoing and incoming referrals for patients as requested.
Maintains medical records which includes requesting records as needed, filing and retrieving records, documents and correspondence in a timely manner
Contacts and reschedules clients that have not shown up for their appointment via phone or letter, and gives chart to the Practitioner for follow up review
Answers telephones which includes routing incoming calls, as appropriate, and documenting accurately telephone messages for clinicians

Provides referrals and assistance as needed to complete the application process to external agencies and/or third party vendors which provide financial assistance for medical care through various government and private programs

Follows computer system and departmental operational procedures and training guidelines to obtain accurate demographic and insurance information on each registration, as monitored by established procedures
